privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://books.toscrape.com/. The export directory must be /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/ and the report path must be /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/thin_content_report.txt. The report must contain three specific word count buckets (<100, 100-300, >300), a list of the 5 thinnest URLs, and remediation advice. Screaming Frog must be used for the audit, and the 'Word Count' column is the primary metric for analysis.
